<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997, which likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral molecular mass is approximately 126.09 Da. The formula that best matches this mass among common C/H/O compositions is C₈H₁₄O (exact mass 126.1045 Da), which is within the expected experimental tolerance for a single‑peak spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
